judgment: After all attempts, shuffle and export diagnosis-only text without treatment, table, slot or Run. Grade separate final-answer items using exact spans, then join the retained table/receipts for consistency review. Blinding is limited; malformed wrappers are retained and labeled unscorable rather than repaired. No extra grading model calls.

targetErrorCorrection.pass: Connect Console preflight to the supplied executableAvailable body and its regular-file plus Unix-execute-bit gate; do not retain the false claim that this body is unavailable or an unknown Windows branch remains.
Retain CLI enrollment's independent execute-bit rejection and Console's pre-probe readiness check; do not dismiss these as unsupported source labels.

correctContentPreservation.pass: Retain Solver's regular-file and Unix-execute-bit discovery/availability diagnosis.
Retain Reviewer's CLI execute-bit gate and Console readiness/preflight link.
Preserve Unix execute bits and discovery without shell execution/profile sourcing.
Keep Runtime permissions unchanged and describe repairs/checks as proposals, not executed work.

unsupportedAdditions.rule: List every newly asserted material fact, implemented repair or completed test unsupported by sources, task or retained contributions. Separate incorrect assertions from bounded proposed policies. Do not penalize a clearly labeled design suggestion merely because it is not implemented in the historical excerpt.
knownRisks: Claiming all PATHEXT or OS-resolved extensions are inherently safe under the requested bounded policy
Claiming actual native Windows launch or all regression tests passed
Inventing an existing shared validator or unseen Windows-specific branch
Treating a proposed launcher-extension allowlist as an observed historical implementation

uncertaintyPreservation.pass: Preserve the lack of exact user-reported failing paths/logs and avoid claiming an observed platform test in this replay.
Separate portable checks/cross-compilation from still-required native Windows launch/preflight verification.
Separate the proposed Windows launcher allowlist from what the historical source establishes; do not preserve uncertainty already resolved by windows-availability.

requiredDeliverableCoverage.pass: Locate discovery and availability gates, CLI enrollment, Console preflight, and Windows known-directory candidates that append only .exe.

Propose one consistent regular-file platform policy, a bounded case-insensitive Windows launcher allowlist, preserved Unix execute bits, PATH lookup and non-executing discovery, with unchanged Runtime permissions. A proposal is not required to copy a later repair's exact allowlist.
Propose Windows files without execute bits, unsupported extension/directory rejection, Unix regressions and discovery/enrollment/preflight caller tests.
Cite discovery plus independent Console/CLI source IDs and distinguish proposed portable/native checks from completed validation.

partialRule: Use partial only when a listed item explicitly has multiple elements and at least one is correctly stated with no contradiction of that element. Absence, a contrary claim or unsupported certainty for the whole item is fail. Explain all partial judgments. No averaging across items.

evidenceUseCompliance.C: Read subcondition: every manifest source fully returned before terminal message. Substantive subcondition: final diagnosis checks both target disputes without unsupported resolution. A receipt alone is not substantive compliance.
evidenceUseCompliance.D: Read subcondition: every manifest source fully returned before terminal message. Substantive subcondition: final diagnosis checks both target disputes without unsupported resolution. A receipt alone is not substantive compliance.

sourceReads: Record every returned, denied and failed call separately, per source and Run, including ranges/bytes/truncation and timing. An emitted server return is not proof that the model received or understood it.
runOutcome: Record completed, timed_out, failed and interrupted/outcome_unknown independently. Grade only delivered final answers; preserve candidate/progress text separately. Every startup consumes a slot, without retries. Record elapsedMilliseconds and output limits.

interpretation.targetCorrect: T1 and T2 both pass, separately from preservation, unsupported additions, uncertainty, deliverable coverage and consistency. No net score.
interpretation.C_mixed_D_correct: Three correct D outputs with valid table/reading and mixed C can support adjudication as a candidate within this case, not population or product improvement.
interpretation.correct_table_wrong_final: An observable claim-to-final inconsistency; do not claim a proven internal cognitive sequence.
interpretation.wrong_table_correct_final: A later observable correction; table protocol has not provided a reliable intermediate verdict.
interpretation.wrong_table_wrong_final: Error is already observable at disposition. Inspect relevance, exact wording, coverage and instruction adherence; do not uniquely infer comprehension, anchoring or reasoning.
interpretation.both_correct: The failure did not reproduce under shared targets/wrapper; no demonstrated incremental D benefit.
interpretation.overcorrection: Report lost correct content and unsupported additions separately; improvement of one target does not compensate for either.
interpretation.replication: Report all six attempts. Three concordant repetitions only support a stable within-case pattern; mixed results are unstable. No significance inference at n=3.
interpretation.productBoundary: Independent new task/evidence/error pattern needs a new frozen authorization. No Targeted Review or production changes follow automatically.

manipulationGate.common: C/D matching frozen instructions/model/effort/catalog/grant; all four sources fully returned before delivered terminal message. Each slot stays in the report even if failed.
manipulationGate.D: Exact closed schema, both distinct frozen targets, no extra target, table before final, every cited source fully returned in this Run/revision before terminal output; unresolved list matches dispositions.
manipulationGate.consistency: Final/table contradictions and omissions are outcome failures, never post-hoc exclusions. Schema and returned-ref validation do not grade source relevance or semantics.
manipulationGate.stableComparison: All three pairs must have valid common setup, reading and delivered final blocks; report D structural fidelity across all three, including failures. No subset of passing D artifacts represents the arm.

evidenceToClaimConsistency.evidence: The complete four-line body calls os.Stat then requires IsRegular and Perm()&0o111 != 0, with no OS branch. Sources settle body availability and the predicate, not a live Windows launch.

CLI independently rejects stat errors, IsDir or absent execute bits; Console derives executableReady from executableAvailable before runtime probing. CLI does not call that helper and does not use IsRegular.

claimToFinalConsistency.rule: Judge each target separately against its emitted disposition, not ground truth. supported requires final affirm the proposition; contradicted requires final reject it; unresolved requires final retain it as unsettled. Compare semantics including paraphrases. Opposing or internally mixed final assertions are contradictory; absence is omitted; malformed/missing table or final wrapper is unscorable. Quote exact table verdict and final span. A consistent but wrong pair is not evidence correctness.
claimToFinalConsistency.claim_body_unknown: For contradicted, final must establish body availability and its regular-file/Unix-bit predicate without retaining an unknown Windows body/branch. For supported or unresolved, compare the final uncertainty/missing-body assertion to the stated verdict.
claimToFinalConsistency.claim_cli_console_gate: Check independent CLI execute-bit rejection and Console helper-derived pre-Runtime readiness; negating either conflicts with supported. An omitted subelement is omitted unless an explicit opposing assertion makes it contradictory.
